Student activist sues anchor over protest coverage

A student activist has filed a defamation lawsuit against Sudhir Chaudhary and DD News over a broadcast aired during youth protests. The lawsuit, filed by the activist, alleges the broadcast contained defamatory content. The specific protests mentioned in relation to the broadcast were organized by the CJP. The legal action seeks damages for the alleged harm caused by the broadcast.
